first_hour_colony_lines: Tap ground to walk; tap a speech marker to approach a colonist.
Tap OPERATIONS for missions and timely preparation choices.
Tap TITLE to leave safely; campaign changes autosave.
first_hour_tactical_lines: Tap a colonist, then a green tile, hostile, or visible action.
Forecasts show deterministic accuracy, cover, armour, and damage.
Tap HELP in battle for the full field manual; tap SAVE at any time.
tutorial.first_hour_skip_notice: Skipping hides teaching prompts but preserves every campaign goal.
tutorial.tactical_manual_paused: The battle is paused while this reference is open.
tactical_read_field_lines: Tap/click a colonist to make them active.
Green tiles are reachable this activation.
Drag to pan; use the mouse wheel to zoom.
Tap a hostile to inspect its forecast, then tap ATTACK to fire.
tactical_spend_phase_lines: Movement and weapons spend action points.
Class, mutation, gear, and overwatch add options.
End Phase warns once if colonists remain ready.
Orange intent lines forecast the first response.
tactical_survive_ground_lines: O Spore bloom: 1 damage and Hindered.
Each hostile faction ignores its own hazard.
tactical_win_contract_lines: Read the objective and live progress at right.
Gold rings mark objectives and extraction.
Some missions require interaction; others survival.
Save and load remain available during battle.
tutorial.tactical_touch_controls: TOUCH // TAP MAP TO INSPECT · DRAG MAP TO PAN · TAP +/- TO ZOOM · TAP NEXT READY / END PHASE / SAVE / LOAD / HELP / LOG
tutorial.tactical_optional_controls: OPTIONAL // KEYS ARROWS / TAB / ENTER / S / L / H / B · PAD D-PAD / A / B / X / Y / RB / START

first_hour_goals.arrival: Tap BEGIN ARRIVAL to answer the refuge distress call.
first_hour_goals.meet_coordinator: Tap Mara Venn's speech marker, then tap CONTINUE.
first_hour_goals.prepare_first_operation: Tap OPERATIONS, inspect GLASSROOT, then tap BRIEF SELECTED MISSION.
first_hour_goals.first_briefing: Tap colonists to choose up to three, then tap DEPLOY SQUAD.
first_hour_goals.first_return: Tap RETURN TO COLONY, then tap Ilya Reed's marker.
first_hour_goals.first_return_colony: Tap Ilya Reed's speech marker, then tap CONTINUE.
first_hour_goals.make_investment: Tap OPERATIONS and choose one affordable preparation investment.
first_hour_goals.second_operation: Tap OPERATIONS, choose the next mission, then tap BRIEF SELECTED MISSION.
first_hour_goals.second_return: Tap RETURN TO COLONY to see what the two operations changed.
first_hour_goals.promise: Read the colony consequence, then tap CONTINUE CAMPAIGN.
first_hour_goals.complete: Protect the colony before the Directorate assault reaches Mirexis.
first_hour_goals.unguided_first_operation: Secure the refuge and neutralise the remaining Brood.
first_hour_goals.unguided_second_operation: Complete the mission and neutralise remaining hostiles.

lessons.select: Tap a colonist to select them.
lessons.move_to_cover: Tap the gold-marked cover tile to move into cover.
lessons.attack: Tap a hostile, review the forecast, then tap ATTACK.
lessons.enemy_phase: Tap END PHASE; if a READY warning appears, tap CONFIRM END again to watch the hostile response.
lessons.objective: Move onto the gold objective, tap COMMAND, then tap SECURE OBJECTIVE.
lessons.ability: Tap COMMAND, then a visible CLASS, MUTATION, or GEAR action.
lessons.apply_learning: Tap a remaining hostile, review the forecast, then tap ATTACK.
